services.name: Dive trip
services.desc: Book Tandem Skydive. We operate 7 days a week from May till the end of September. If you would like assistance with booking your skydive or have any questions, our office staff will be happy to help. We operate out of our office only when skydive reservations are taking place. Should that be the case, please reach us through phone or email.Please note: the 13,000 ft. Tandem Skydive is an add-on available at the Drop Zone on the day of your booking. Best Skydiving in Canada! Giving you a birds eye view of our great Canadian Rocky Mountains. Are you ready for an extreme adventure Canada experience! When you’re thinking of Skydiving Calgary, Skydiving Canmore, Skydiving Banff, Skydiving Jasper

services.name: Super Tandem
services.desc: Skydiving is Safe! Skydiving is a very safe sport. And the stats prove it - as long as you read the full stats and not the ones that are trying to prove it not as safe as something else. If you’re sitting at home on the couch, then that’s probably safer than skydiving, although you may get heart disease. Are you more likely to die in a car accident than skydiving? Yes! It might not seem like it at the time, but alot of activities are far more dangerous, and potentially more lethal than skydiving. We are willing to bet that you do all, or most of those things without even considering the risks that may arise from partaking in those activities. Don’t get us wrong, that’s a good thing! Lifel

blurb: Guests experience a tandem skydive from 13,000 feet with breathtaking views of the Canadian Rockies and the Kicking Horse River. The freefall is about 60 seconds at 120 MPH, followed by a 5-minute canopy flight. The drop zone is located in Golden, BC, near six national parks including Banff and Jasper.
extraNote: Tandem skydiving is designed to be very safe with two parachutes (primary and emergency backup) · Jump will be cancelled if drugs or alcohol consumed within 24 hours · Located in Golden, British Columbia, at the skydive drop zone. · Open until September 27, 2026

quotes.text: Incredible!!! Incredible!! It’s been a week since my friends & I jumped for the first time and we’re still on a high and can’t stop telling anyone that’ll listen haha. All 3 of us were so nervous but all 3 of our guys were so so helpful. I had Jay and he was amazing! He could see I was shutting down & was in my head prior to the jump - he walked me through the jump step by step several times & walked me through focusing on my breathing. Thanks to Jay - my first time jumping was incredible and I genuinely can’t wait to do it again. Everyone at extreme yeti was amazing ❤️ more...less...

First time and won't be my last! What an incredible experience! Golden, BC is such a beautiful place, it was beyond epic to see it from 10,000 ft. The crew at Extreme Yeti is incredibly professional, experienced, fun, and energetic! I thought I would have been more scared but they made it simple and easy to relax. The ride up gives great views and the ride down takes your breath away, literally! 😉 20/10 will do again! more...less...

Wow - everybody should do that once in life minimum Guys, that was AWESOME! I was really flashed by that experience and can fully recommend that to everybody who is looking for a real adventure. Professional staff, wonderful weather, amazing views and then, when the door opens an WOW, WOW, WOW. Everybody should have seen that in life, for me, it was a life-changing experience and I just can say thank you to everybody. more...less...

Extreme Yeti Skydiving in Golden BC = AWESOME!!! The Staff was absolutely AWESOME!!! They were all very freindly and relatable; I could have hung out with them all day. Really good clear instructions, and they love doing what they do. I could not have asked for a better group to do my first jump with. The videos are Great and now I can prove to my friends/family that I jumped out of a perrfectly good airplane! more...less...
